title: Stained Glass Sunrise
description: A black and white line drawing of a bald man with a surprised expression, shown from the shoulders up, facing a vibrant stained glass sun with radiating green rays. The background consists of a colorful mosaic of stained glass panels featuring flowers with teal petals and black centers.
prompt: A surreal mixed media artwork on lined notebook paper featuring a stark black and white line drawing of a bald man with wide eyes and open mouth looking toward the right. He is surrounded by a vibrant stained glass composition with a large yellow sun, radiating lime green rays, and teal flowers with black centers set against a fragmented mosaic background of orange, blue, and brown glass pieces.
